lines.en: I squeeze my bell and push forward.
The current carries me over the seagrass.
Squeeze and release, and I drift away.

lines.zh: 我软软地撞开一片水草。
lines.en: I softly part a clump of seagrass.
Warm water pushes me toward the shallows.
My tentacles trail behind like thin threads.
I turn slowly and ride the flow.
A wave sways me, and I sway three times.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑行一小段。
lines.en: I skim just above the sand for a while.
My bell edge twitches; I rise a little.
No rush — jellyfish never hurry.
I pass through sunbeams and glow.
The ebb tide sends me toward the reef.
I drift slowly but never lose my way.
I ride the warm current up to the surface.

lines.zh: 我的伞盖碰到沙，又弹起来。
lines.en: My bell touches sand and springs back up.
A shoal of small fish circles me.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到水压变轻了。
lines.en: I feel the water pressure ease.
I hang in the water, opening and closing.
Sunlight passes through me onto the sand.

lines.zh: 我数着水流的方向发呆。
lines.en: I stare and count the directions of the current.

lines.zh: 有条小鱼从我触手间穿过。
lines.en: A small fish slips between my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我轻轻抖掉伞上的细沙。
lines.en: I gently shake the fine sand off my bell.
The seagrass sways, and so do I.
I think nothing; I only drift.
The water cools; I curl my bell edge.

lines.zh: 一只海龟的影子掠过去。
lines.en: A turtle's shadow glides past.
My body is like a piece of jelly.

lines.zh: 我听见远处闷闷的鲸歌。
lines.en: I hear a muffled whale song far away.
Bubbles rise from beneath my bell.
I doze in the middle of the water layer.
I know these shallows very well.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我浮上来看。
lines.en: You stand on shore; I float up to look.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进我的浅海。
lines.en: Your shadow falls into my shallows.

lines.zh: 我朝你开合伞盖，算打招呼。
lines.en: I open my bell at you as a greeting.
Reaching for me? The water is too shallow.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里那只木桶。
lines.en: I stare at the wooden bucket in your hands.

lines.zh: 你的脸在水面晃成一片。
lines.en: Your face wobbles on the water surface.
I drift closer, then back off half a foot.

lines.zh: 我这只小箱水母，也盯着你。
lines.en: Small box jelly or not, I'm watching you.

lines.zh: 别踩水，会惊到我的触手。
lines.en: Do not splash; it startles my tentacles.
I recognize the sand on your boots.
Half my bell is knocked out of shape.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的触手断了两根。
lines.en: That cost me two tentacles.
I curl into a ball and slowly recover.

lines.zh: 伞盖被戳穿，我漏出一点光。
lines.en: My bell is pierced; a little light leaks out.
The pain sinks me a little deeper.
There is a dent in my bell.
Do not hit me; I have only three points of health.
Slime seeps from the wound.
I quiver and barely stay afloat.
I will remember you for that.

lines.zh: 那股暖流一过来，我就想跟。
lines.en: When that warm current comes, I want to follow.

lines.zh: 你晃的东西，我看着就晕。
lines.en: The thing you wave makes me dizzy.

lines.zh: 亮光在水里碎开，好想去。
lines.en: The light shatters underwater; I want it.

lines.zh: 我朝气泡升起的地方挪。
lines.en: I inch toward where the bubbles rise.
This water is warm; I hate to leave.

lines.zh: 你手里的黏液球在发亮吗？
lines.en: Is that slime ball in your hand glowing?

lines.zh: 影子一晃，我就转过去了。
lines.en: A shadow shifts, and I turn toward it.

lines.zh: 我跟着浪尖，一点点靠近。
lines.en: I follow the wave crest, nearer and nearer.

lines.zh: 有东西在动，我非看不可。
lines.en: Something moves; I must look.

lines.zh: 那股味儿像海草，我过去。
lines.en: That smell is like seagrass; I go over.
You bump me, and I bounce away.
You squashed my bell flat.
Easy — I am all water inside.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我的触手缠住了。
lines.en: One bump and my tentacles tangle.

lines.zh: 我飘回来，又贴上你的腿。
lines.en: I drift back and stick to your leg.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推离了暖流。
lines.en: That shoved me out of the warm current.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两团果冻。
lines.en: We collide like two blobs of jelly.
You knocked me over onto my back.

lines.zh: 别推，我方向感本来就差。
lines.en: Do not push; I have poor direction anyway.

lines.zh: 我像一只小箱，随水撞你。
lines.en: Like a little box, I drift into you.

lines.zh: 另一只水母的伞在发亮。
lines.en: Another jellyfish's bell is glowing.
We drift side by side, tentacles brushing.
In the warm water we open and close together.
It has caught my current.
Two jellyfish, one seagrass bed.
I circle it once, slowly.

lines.zh: 我们的伞盖映着同一片光。
lines.en: Our bells catch the same light.

lines.zh: 这一带很快会有小水母。
lines.en: Soon there will be little jellies here.

lines.zh: 它碰我一下，我就亮一下。
lines.en: It touches me, and I brighten.
Do not crowd us; we are both soft.

lines.zh: 我裹住你掉的东西，又滑掉。
lines.en: I wrap around your dropped item, then lose it.

lines.zh: 水底那枚东西，我推了一下。
lines.en: I nudge that thing on the seabed.

lines.zh: 黏液球沉下来，贴着我的伞。
lines.en: A slime ball sinks and sticks to my bell.
I cannot hold it; I have no hands.

lines.zh: 这块东西从我触手间漏走了。
lines.en: This thing slipped through my tentacles.

lines.zh: 我试着顶它上岸，失败了。
lines.en: I try to push it ashore and fail.

lines.zh: 它挂在我伞边，晃来晃去。
lines.en: It hangs from my bell, swinging.

lines.zh: 我把它盖在身子底下藏着。
lines.en: I cover it under my body to hide it.
The heavy thing drags me downward.

lines.zh: 我捡不起来，只能围着转。
lines.en: I cannot pick it up; I just circle it.

lines.zh: 水里有东西在动，我转过去。
lines.en: Something moves in the water; I turn.
I have my eye on that shadow.

lines.zh: 它离我的触手只有半臂。
lines.en: It is half an arm from my tentacles.
I close my bell and prepare to drift over.

lines.zh: 有东西撞进我的范围了。
lines.en: Something has entered my reach.
I slowly line up with that movement.
It swims too fast for me to follow.

lines.zh: 我的触手先感觉到了它。
lines.en: My tentacles sensed it first.
Hold still; I am drifting toward you.
The target is close; I am in no hurry.
I follow it, opening and closing.
It goes left; my bell tilts left.

lines.zh: 我锁住那点晃动的影子。
lines.en: I lock onto that wobbling shadow.
Seagrass blocks me; I drift over it.

lines.zh: 它躲进礁缝，我在外面等。
lines.en: It hides in the reef crack; I wait outside.
All my tentacles point toward it.
When it stops, I close in a foot.

lines.zh: 我盯得很紧，虽然游得慢。
lines.en: I watch closely, though I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 这猎物不大，够我碰一下。
lines.en: The prey is small — one touch is enough.
It circles, and I circle slowly too.

lines.zh: 我的触手扫过它，它一抖。
lines.en: My tentacles brush it, and it shudders.
I press close and let it go numb.
No teeth — this touch is all I have.
My touch makes it recoil.
A soft bump from me, and it panics.
The stings on my tentacles graze it.
I only want it to back away.
That touch tired me a little too.
It fled; my bell is still quivering.

lines.zh: 别怪我，是你先撞上来的。
lines.en: Do not blame me — you bumped into me first.

lines.zh: 我在温暖浅海里慢慢张开。
lines.en: I open slowly in the warm shallows.

lines.zh: 海草床里，多了我这一团。
lines.en: One more blob in the seagrass bed.

lines.zh: 温水把我从光里推出来。
lines.en: Warm water pushes me out of the light.

lines.zh: 我和另一只一起漂出来。
lines.en: Another jellyfish and I drift out together.
Newly formed, my bell is still tiny.

lines.zh: 这片浅海多了一点透明。
lines.en: These shallows gained a bit of transparency.
I emerge from a gap in the seagrass.

lines.zh: 潮水把我放在这片礁边。
lines.en: The tide set me down by this reef.
I open my eyes to blue on every side.
Do not step there; I just drifted in.
Boiling water curls the rim of my bell.

lines.zh: 搁浅在沙上，我的伞盖贴成一片。
lines.en: Stranded on the sand, my bell flattens.

lines.zh: 我不该离开水的，我快干了。
lines.en: I should not leave the water; I am drying out.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我震成一片雾。
lines.en: The blast scatters me into mist.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的伞，留了个洞。
lines.en: An arrow pierced my bell and left a hole.

lines.zh: 这股力量让我全身发麻。
lines.en: This force numbs me all over.

lines.zh: 水里没有小东西，我越来越薄。
lines.en: Nothing small is in the water; I grow thinner.

lines.zh: 电流穿过海水，我的触手全缩了。
lines.en: Current runs through the seawater; all my tentacles retract.

lines.zh: 黑暗里没有水，我飘不动。
lines.en: There is no water in the dark; I cannot drift.
